title: Relay Balance Window
statement: A relay station records a signed energy adjustment for each tick. Positive values add energy and negative values remove it. Choose one non-empty consecutive window of ticks whose adjustments sum to target. Return the greatest possible number of ticks in that window, or 0 if no such window exists. Adjustments may include zero and negative values. Return only the length; do not return the window itself.
functionSignature: def relay_balance_window(adjustments: list[int], target: int) -> int:
constraints: 1 <= len(adjustments) <= 100000; -1000000 <= adjustments[i] <= 1000000; -1000000 <= target <= 1000000. The window must be non-empty. Inputs are not necessarily sorted or positive.

examples.explanation: Ticks 0 through 3 sum to 2 - 1 + 2 - 1 = 2. The whole record sums to 4, so the longest qualifying window has four ticks.
The whole record sums to zero, so all three ticks count.
Every window has an even sum, so no window totals 3.
